# Sheet digest — derived, do not edit

`npm run cid:leadpack` regenerates this from the sheets themselves. Every sheet's
decision, the contract key it supplies, and what it says is **not** its business.
That last column is the boundary: if something you need sits in it, that thing is
unowned and you should say so rather than assume someone has it.

Read this **instead of** the sibling sheets. They cost ~9,000 lines to learn ~90
lines of fact.

| sheet | decided | provides | what it forces on others | explicitly not its business |
